When the object pointer dword_8AC4C8 is non-null, calls the vtable offset +8 __thiscall method (this = dword_8AC4C8) as a query; if that returns non-zero, invokes the vtable offset +16 __thiscall method (this = dword_8AC4C8) as the action. Proceed to the action stage only when the vtable offset +8 query returned non-zero.
Indirect __thiscall through the vtable pointer at *dword_8AC4C8 + 16, passing dword_8AC4C8 as this, as the action stage.
